name: lantern-works-gpu-prices
description: Read-only MCP server that compares cloud GPU rental prices (H100, H200, A100, L40S, RTX 4090/5090 and more) across tracked providers, cheapest first, with each price's vendor source page and check time, price history, recent price changes and GPU job cost estimates. Free, no API key.

tools.name: compare_gpu_prices
tools.description: Hourly rental prices for a GPU model across tracked providers, cheapest first, each with source_url and check time.

tools.name: get_price_changes
tools.description: GPU price moves among tracked providers since a date, newest first.

tools.name: estimate_job_cost
tools.description: Cost of one GPU job among tracked providers, cheapest first, with assumptions and missing costs.

tools.name: optimize_stack
tools.description: Cheapest tracked plan per usage line, with sources.

tools.name: optimize_agent_stack
tools.description: Cheapest cited option per component from a plain-text agent description.

tools.name: rebuild_quote
tools.description: Reopen a past quote receipt and revalidate it against today's feed.

tools.name: search_deals
tools.description: Search the AI-infra deals feed by text, category, offer type, price and tags.

tools.name: get_deal
tools.description: Return the full public record for one deal id.

uvx.description: Run locally over stdio from PyPI

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint, same read-only tools; no install or key

examples.title: Cheapest H100
examples.prompt: What is the cheapest H100 to rent per hour right now? Show sources.

examples.title: Job cost
examples.prompt: Estimate the cost of 100 hours on one A100 80GB, cheapest first.

examples.title: Price changes
examples.prompt: Which GPU rental prices changed in the last 7 days?
